description: This file defines the 'EventsService' interface, which provides Retrofit HTTP client method signatures for interacting with event-related REST API endpoints.

classes.name: EventsService
classes.description: Retrofit interface for event endpoints, including methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting events.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Fetches a list of events filtered by optional 'from' and 'to' date parameters.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves a specific event by its unique identifier.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event with the provided event data.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing event identified by its ID with new event data.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event specified by its ID.
